privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.subtitle: How we protect your privacy and handle your data when you use BitTasker to connect with taskers and taskees.

philosophy.title: Our Philosophy: You Are in Control
philosophy.content: BitTasker is fundamentally different from traditional gig platforms. We are built on Nostr, a decentralized network. This means you own your identity and your data. You interact with the platform using a cryptographic key pair (a public and private key) that only you control. We never have access to your private key.

data_collection.title: What Information Do We Collect? (Almost None)
data_collection.content: Because of our decentralized design, we do not have access to or store any of your non-public personally identifiable information (PII), unless you make it public or provide it to us.

public_data.title: Information That is Public By Default
public_data.intro: When you use a decentralized network like Nostr, some information is public by its very nature. This includes:
public_data.npub: Your Nostr Public Key (npub): This is your public identifier, like a username.
public_data.profile: Your Public Profile: Any information you add to your profile, such as a username, avatar, or bio, is publicly visible.
public_data.actions: Public Actions: Posting a task or leaving a review are public events on the Nostr network.
public_data.transactions: Bitcoin Transactions: Transactions on the Bitcoin blockchain are public by nature, though they do not contain personal identifiers beyond wallet addresses.
public_data.warning: We strongly encourage you to use caution and discretion when deciding what information to make public.

private_data.title: Information That is Private
private_data.content: All direct messages between users on BitTasker are end-to-end encrypted (E2EE). We, the platform operators, cannot read your private conversations. Only you and the person you are communicating with can decrypt and view the messages.

location_data.title: Location Data
location_data.content: BitTasker accesses your device location when you use task location features (e.g., setting a task location or browsing nearby tasks). Location is used only in the foreground and is not stored or tracked in the background. You can deny location permission and manually enter addresses instead.

email_data.title: Email Address
email_data.content: If you choose to set up account recovery, we collect your email address solely for sending recovery codes. Your email is not used for marketing or shared with third parties.

device_data.title: Device Identifiers
device_data.content: We generate a random device identifier to associate your sessions with your device for security purposes (e.g., recognizing trusted devices). This identifier is not an advertising ID and is not shared with third parties.

third_party.title: Third-Party Services
third_party.intro: BitTasker uses the following third-party services to operate:
third_party.sentry: Error Monitoring (GlitchTip): We collect anonymized crash reports and error logs to improve app stability. No personally identifiable information is included.
third_party.firebase: Push Notifications (Firebase Cloud Messaging): If you enable notifications, we use Google's Firebase Cloud Messaging to deliver them. Your device token is stored on our servers to route notifications.
third_party.maps: Maps (Google Maps): We use Google Maps to display task locations and perform address lookups. Location coordinates you provide are sent to Google for geocoding.
third_party.translate: Translation (Google Translate): When auto-translation is enabled, message text is sent to Google Translate API for translation. You can disable this feature in settings.
third_party.turnstile: Bot Protection (Cloudflare Turnstile): During signup, Cloudflare processes a browser challenge to verify you are human.
third_party.analytics: Analytics (Umami): We use privacy-focused analytics to understand aggregate usage patterns. No personal data is collected.
third_party.swaps: Card and bank purchases: buying bitcoin is handled by the payment provider. BitTasker does not see your card or identity documents. The bitcoin is paid to your own address. There is no in-app crypto swap.

analytics.title: Marketing Analytics
analytics.intro: BitTasker may use marketing analytics tools to gather aggregate data for the purpose of measuring and improving our marketing efforts. These tools help us understand how users interact with our website and which marketing channels are most effective.
analytics.warning_body: We do not collect personally identifiable information (PII) through these marketing tools, nor do we wish to collect such information. Any data collected is anonymous and aggregated, used solely to enhance user experience and optimize our marketing strategies.
analytics.usage: Anonymous Usage Patterns: How users navigate through our website
analytics.referrals: Referral Sources: Which websites or platforms directed traffic to BitTasker
analytics.performance: Campaign Performance: How different marketing initiatives perform

use_of_info.title: How We Use Information
use_of_info.content: Since we don't have access to your private data, we can't use it. We do not sell, rent, or share any personal information with third parties for marketing or any other purpose.

storage.title: Data Storage and Retention
storage.content: Your public data is stored on the distributed network of Nostr relays. BitTasker does not operate a central database of user content, but does provide a Nostr relay to BitTasker users at no cost. Your data exists on the network for as long as the relays you've published to choose to store it.

rights.title: Your Rights and Choices
rights.content: You have the ultimate right to your data. You can choose to stop using BitTasker at any time. Since you control your keys, you control your data. You can also connect to the Nostr network with other clients to manage the data associated with your public key, and export your private Nostr key to use on other Nostr clients while retaining your data and reputation.

changes.title: Changes to This Policy
changes.content: We may update this Privacy Policy from time to time. We will notify you of any changes by posting the new policy on this page. We encourage you to review this Privacy Policy periodically for any changes. By using BitTasker, you agree to the Privacy Policy in effect at the time of your use.

contact.title: Contact Us
contact.content: If you have any questions about this Privacy Policy, you can contact us.
